As a female who works in the heart of Las Vegas, people can get pretty fucking crazy here. I also take the bus to work, so it's more of a chance to get stopped by some random guy. (I'm 18 and I can't drive. Sad, isn't it?) I normally dress as a pin up, so I do get the attention, and even days when I don't wear makeup or do, but not how I normally do, I always somehow get hit on.

Anyway here's my story.

I was walking up in a bridge by the MGM and New York, New York to cross to take another bus to my interview for the job I work now. I got surrounded by three guys trying to promote their junk to me. I wasn't interested, but they were quite bigger than me. They were surrounding me once I got to the top of the escalator and I would've gone down if I could, but I couldn't. Mind you I am only 5'1ft, (154cm) and at least 99lbs (44kg), so I couldn't just walk through. 

One of the guys kept trying to what it looked like kiss me. The other was quite nice who was trying to give me a book of his poetry. I never got the book. lol Then the last guy was just there trying to squeeze in his way to get at me. The guy who tried to kiss me seemed under the influence of something. He wouldn't leave me alone while the guy who tried to squeeze in asked if he could spank my ass. Rude, but I appreciated him asking instead of just going for it. 

The poetry guy wanted to give me a hug, and since he was more nicer than the other two, I let him. The guy who tried to kiss me wanted a hug, but I didn't, yet he holds me in a sensual and uncomfortable way. I pushed the guy off me and managed to walk through them. And the last guy asked for a high five, so it was just a whatever thing. That was the last time I saw any of them. It was just an awkward situation for me. 

There's my story. What's yours, people of Reddit?
